dedupe_keys.name: european heat pump keymark population dataset and cop models for cold climate building simulation

description: A Tallinn University of Technology team deposits fitted population coefficient-of-performance models for European air-to-water heat pumps, alongside training data and Python conversion code. Zenodo lists one public ZIP. The description states 53,551 deduplicated EN 14825 test points, 3,395 heat-pump groups, a cold-climate variant, Estonian building load profiles, and scripts converting seasonal ratings to hourly COP for dynamic building-energy simulation. The August 2026 version adds a temporal hold-out of 66 unseen models and an external laboratory hold-out of 102 units; these are provider-reported results, not independently reproduced. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this fitted population model. A limitation is that European KEYMARK technical values and WPZ measurements retain their upstream database rights; Zenodo distinguishes CC BY 4.0 derived tables from MIT code. The public ZIP was not downloaded or executed, so code dependencies, fitted coefficients and hold-out errors remain unchecked. Cold-climate transfer to other equipment or buildings requires validation.
